test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Research has proved that meteors have largely destructed and impackted earth.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impackted**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**impacted**".
 
• The incorrect spelling in the sentence is "**impackted**".
 
• The word "**impacted**" means to have a strong effect on something, usually in a negative way. (किसी चीज़ पर गहरा प्रभाव डालना, आमतौर पर नकारात्मक तरीके से)
 
 
• **Example**: *The new regulations impacted the way businesses operated in the industry.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Research **means the systematic investigation or study to discover new facts or information. (नए तथ्यों या जानकारी की खोज के लिए व्यवस्थित जांच या अध्ययन)
 
• **Proved **means to demonstrate the truth or existence of something through evidence or argument. (साक्ष्य या तर्क के माध्यम से किसी चीज़ की सच्चाई या अस्तित्व को प्रदर्शित करना)
 
• **Destructed** means to cause severe damage or ruin. (गंभीर क्षति या बर्बादी का कारण बनना)
